residency.heading: Azerbaijan TRC & Temporary Residence Assistance
residency.body: Relocate, invest, and build your future in Azerbaijan. We provide comprehensive legal document preparation, sworn translation, medical checkup assistance, and State Migration Service appointment scheduling.

pathway1.title: Company / Business Setup
pathway1.desc: Form an LLC (MMC) in Azerbaijan and obtain TRC residency as a company founder or executive director.

pathway2.title: Real Estate Investment
pathway2.desc: Acquire qualifying residential or commercial property in Azerbaijan exceeding State statutory value requirements.

pathway3.title: University / Student TRC
pathway3.desc: Enroll in accredited medical, engineering, or business universities across Baku with student residency support.

pathway4.title: Family Reunification
pathway4.desc: Extend residency permits to spouses and dependent children with comprehensive document and translation support.

residency.noticeText: SIRFPK provides consultancy and application assistance. Approval of residence permits is subject to the decision of the relevant Azerbaijani authorities.

step1.title: Initial Eligibility & Pathway Selection
step1.detail: Evaluate eligibility (Business Setup, Property, or Education) and compile checklist.

step2.title: Document Legalization & Notarized Translation
step2.detail: Apostille, certified Azerbaijani translation, and local tax identification number (VÖEN).

step3.title: Medical Clearance & Biometric Submission
step3.detail: Accompaniment to certified medical facility & State Migration Service biometric appointment.

step4.title: TRC Issuance & Registration
step4.detail: Collection of the official Temporary Residence Card (valid 1 to 2 years, renewable).

property.heading: Buy Property in Azerbaijan with Confidence
property.subheading: Prime residential apartments in Baku White City, Caspian coastal sea-view villas, and high-yield commercial assets with complete foreign ownership verification.
property.disclaimerText: Property prices and rental returns are indicative and subject to market conditions. Foreign buyers should conduct independent legal, financial, and title due diligence. Investment outcomes vary and should be independently assessed.
property.pageHeading: Buy Property in Azerbaijan with Confidence

property.pageDisclaimerText: Property prices, floor plans, and rental yields are indicative estimates. Foreign buyers must undergo formal notarized state registry verification (Kupcha/Çıxarış). Real estate values and yields can fluctuate based on broader market dynamics.

company.heading: Company Registration in Azerbaijan (MMC Formation)
company.subheading: Establish your company in Baku with 100% foreign ownership, competitive corporate tax rates, and access to regional Silk Road markets.

step1.title: Initial Consultation
step1.desc: Define business objectives, shareholding ratios, and capital structure.

step2.title: Choose Structure
step2.desc: Select LLC (Məhdud Məsuliyyətli Cəmiyyət - MMC) or Branch Office.

step3.title: Prepare Documents
step3.desc: Draft articles of association, shareholder resolutions, and notarized translations.

step4.title: Submit Application
step4.desc: Filing with the State Tax Service / Ministry of Economy single-window portal.

step5.title: Company Registration
step5.desc: Obtain official Certificate of State Registration, Tax ID (VÖEN), and ASAN Imza.

step6.title: Bank Account Setup
step6.desc: Assistance opening corporate bank accounts in AZN, USD, and EUR in Baku.

step7.title: Ongoing Support
step7.desc: Accounting, tax reporting compliance, office address, and founder TRC residency.

advantage4.title: Founder TRC Eligibility
advantage4.desc: Direct qualification for Azerbaijan Temporary Residence Permit (TRC) as a registered company director.
